items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] How old were you when you got married now, Paul?

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. When did you first hear the blues? Did you, when you were a boy, did they sing the blues or play the blues on the instruments? When you were a boy learning on guitar? I was the first man that composed the blues. I used to play by Billy Phillips on Zero and Aberdeen. Now, I'll tell you how I learned the blues. Me and my friend, Jimmy Brown, that used to be in our band, and he used to be the bass player. So he had a woman that used to come on the piano. We had a piano. So one day he told me, say, Pike,…
How old were you when you got married now, Paul?
